phase1_structured_objective_and_crf.note: Composed root x quality head underperforms the flat chord head; Viterbi smoothing is neutral-to-negative. The structured loss leaves the flat head intact (exact 0.527, MIREX 0.667).

phase2_96_frame_3_block_3_seeds_swa.note: 3 seeds show ~0.018 macro variance; seed2 is best macro, seed3 best exact/MIREX. SWA is neutral.

phase3_ensembles.note: Ensembling is the strongest lever: s2ft+s3 gives the best macro/exact/MIREX/ECE; FT1+balancedFT gives the best slash (0.266).

support_evidence.note: The full 102-class macro gate includes 34 classes with <5 frames. Minimum-support macro passes 0.45; the gate definition is unchanged.

phase4_decision: Choose synthetic rare-chord/inversion guitar data over more full-mix data: the remaining gap is rare-class/inversion recall, not full-mix volume. Render ChoCo symbolic/LA MIDI with guitar soundfonts and amps, labels from MIDI, balanced over qualities and inversions; blend with real guitar data. Verify licences first.

phase4_synthetic_guitar.source_annotations: Isophonics + Billboard + JAAH .lab files (CC BY 4.0; JAAH is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so the corpus is research-only)
phase4_synthetic_guitar.synthesis: additive guitar-like pluck, 6 harmonics, random timbres, inversions from bass, 1.6 s CQT windows
phase4_synthetic_guitar.fine_tune: seed2-FT + guitar sources + synthetic, 6 epochs, lr 2e-4, context 96, 3 blocks
phase4_synthetic_guitar.verdict: Positive but small at this scale; rare-class/inversion synthetic data helps exact/MIREX/ECE but not full macro. Scale up windows/classes before another gate run.

phase4b_synthetic_scale.change: multi-window rendering (up to 4.8 s per segment) and 2x synthetic sampling weight
phase4b_synthetic_scale.verdict: Scaling this synthetic corpus is not a reliable win: macro +0.002 but exact/MIREX/ECE regress. The 3,091-window corpus remains the better finalist for exact/MIREX/ECE; further synthetic effort should change the timbre/domain or source rather than just add windows.

reports_note: phase4_synth_* use the 3,091-window corpus; phase4b_synth2_* use the 6,764-window scale-up.

posthoc_calibration.result: negative for macro; only ECE improves when no prior is applied
posthoc_calibration.note: Fitting temperature/prior on guitar val overfits and lowers test macro; do not use for the macro gate.

three_model_ensembles.note: Three-model averaging dilutes the best pair; keep the two-model finalists.

verdict: CQT ensembles are saturated: best macro 0.359, exact 0.576, MIREX 0.699, bass 0.834, slash 0.266, ECE 0.0147. MuQ pretrained features (layers 2/6) are negative (val 0.194/0.076 vs CQT 0.289), and guitar-only synthetic fine-tuning is negative (0.289→0.266). Macro and slash gates still fail; Phase 5/6 blocked. Closing them requires more real guitar data (GOAT access) or a research-grade representation/adaptation change.

phase4c_context_capacity.verdict: 128/4 is worse than 96/3 on the external test despite higher val macro; context/capacity is saturated/overfitting beyond 96 frames.

phase4c_cross_context_ensembles.verdict: Cross-context diversity helps: the 2-model 96+128 ensemble is the best macro/MIREX/ECE point (0.359/0.693/0.0147). Adding a third context dilutes macro but improves slash/bass.

phase4d_muq_pretrained.pipeline: 24 kHz audio → MuQ hidden state → 25→10 Hz resample → fixed Gaussian projection 1024→128 → 16-frame windows

layer6_val.note: best val epoch 2; training diverged to chance

layer2_val.note: best val epoch 3; lower layer helps but still far below CQT

phase4d_muq_pretrained.verdict: MuQ features did not transfer in this pipeline: layer 6 val macro 0.076, layer 2 0.194, versus CQT guitar-only 0.318. Do not scale MuQ without a different adaptation/probing/domain-alignment strategy. MuQ weights are NC, research-only.

guitaronly_synth_finetune_val.note: synthetic fine-tune of the guitar-only model hurt val (0.289→0.266); not evaluated externally

phase4e_real_guitar_only_ensembles.verdict: Adding the guitar-only model improves exact/MIREX (0.576/0.699) but not macro (0.354 vs 0.359). Synthetic fine-tuning of the guitar-only model hurts. The CQT ensemble is saturated.
